blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda has resigned from his post, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said Saturday. “He resigned […] His resignation was already accepted,” Remulla said when asked about Aguda during the ombudsman’s radio show over DZRH.
